item.title: Sylvie Cachay's death at Soho House: accident or murder?
item.description: The son of an Oscar winner is accused of killing his girlfriend, a swimsuit designer, at a New York City hotel.

item.title: Trump halts new Iran strikes; Saudi leader calls for calm
item.description: On Feb. 28, President Trump announced major U.S.-Israeli combat operations against Iran, but later called off further strikes.

item.title: Dodgers acquire Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal in major trade
item.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers have secured the top trade target, two-time AL Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal.

item.title: Fatalities and injuries reported after Idaho In-N-Out shooting
item.description: Police are responding to an active shooter situation near an In-N-Out in Idaho on Saturday evening.
